title: 1 Bazooka vs 1 Granny
summary: Tony's queen is swapped for a Bazooka (queen + nightrider + camel) vs chess.com's 'Grandma' bot rated 2900. From the start position Bf5-style camel drop is mate in one, so he restarts with 1.d4 to give Granny a chance, plays a normal game, trades down, promotes and mates with Qe2 (~14:45).
rules: Player's queen replaced by a Bazooka.
Bazooka moves as queen + nightrider (repeated knight leaps in one direction, blockable at each landing square) + camel ((3,1) single leap).
Note: from the initial position the bazooka has an immediate mate (camel to f5 hitting e7/e8 per transcript ~0:46); Tony chose 1.d4 instead.
